slides.title: A Day at the Library
slides.text: Luna Owl loved the Old Oak Library. It was her favourite place. So many books lived there. Each book held a new story. Luna flew to a tall, wooden shelf. She saw a very big book. Its cover was bright blue. It looked very special.

slides.title: Missing Letters
slides.text: Luna looked closely at the book. Oh dear! Some letters were gone. The title looked like “C_OU_S.” Luna blinked her big golden eyes. “Every question opens a new adventure!” she chirped softly. She wanted to know the book's name.

slides.title: A Little Clue
slides.text: Luna looked around the shelf. What could help her? She saw a tiny, sparkly feather. It lay right next to the book. On the feather, a little 'C' was drawn. “A 'C'!” Luna said. “What word starts with 'C'?”

slides.title: Finding the Word
slides.text: Luna thought very hard. She remembered a book about clouds. Clouds float high in the sky. She looked again at the letters: “C_OU_S.” Then, she saw another feather! It had a little 'L' on it. “C-L-O-U-D-S!” she sounded out.

slides.title: Happy Reading
slides.text: Luna felt very happy. Her curiosity helped her. The book was called “Clouds of Wonder.” She carefully read the first page. It was about soft, fluffy clouds. Luna felt calm and proud. Learning new letters was a wonderful adventure.

With her big golden eyes and curious mind, Luna sets out to discover what the book's title truly is.
